title: The Last Verdict
author: Freya Oyelaran
blurb: Sebastian Winterbourne, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
